children: Premier Explosives Ltd. has received an export order worth $33.603 million, or approximately ₹311 crore, from an international entity for the manufacture and supply of defence explosives, the company said in an exchange filing on Saturday, November 21.
The order involves the manufacturing and supply of defence explosives and has been awarded by an international client.
It will be executed within 12 months.
The company also said that neither its promoters nor promoter-group companies have any interest in the entity that awarded the order. The contract does not fall under related-party transactions.
Headquartered in Secunderabad, Telangana, Premier Explosives manufactures high-energy materials, solid propellants, and detonators.

Its Managing Director TV Chowdhary earlier told CNBC-TV18 that the company is targeting ₹600-700 crore in revenue in FY27. That target was revised to ₹500-600 crore during the latest earnings announcement.
Premier Explosives reported a 92% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 revenue from operations to ₹145.3 crore, while EBITDA rose 161% to ₹17.2 crore, with the EBITDA margin improving to 11.9%.
However, profit after tax fell 33% YoY to ₹12 crore. For H1 FY27, revenue grew 13.8% to ₹247.8 crore, while PAT declined 54.8% to ₹15 crore.
The company said its order book stood at ₹1,642 crore as of October 2026, with around 96% coming from the defence segment.
Shares of the company closed at ₹548.60, down 1.89% for the day on Friday on the NSE.

title: Premier Explosives gets ₹311-crore export order for defence explosives
